name: smwmusic-lemmings-3-the-lemmings-chronicles-egypt-tribe-theme
title: Lemmings 3: The Lemmings Chronicles - Egypt Tribe Theme 1
description:
One of the themes that plays for the Egyptian tribe in Lemmings 3. In my opinion, the ideal location for this song would be in a puzzle-ish pyramid or temple; something not too action oriented.

Note: It's not recommended to use this in levels with the timer on, as the tempo increase will break the percussion. Please set the timer to 0 or disable the tempo hike following the instructions from here ($008E5C).


Update (01/06/20):

- Updated to use .brr instead of .bnk as per remoderation.
- Optimized to reduce insert size by 720 bytes.
